metadata.division: DIVISION 5-1-6. SUPPLEMENT STANDARDS FOR NONRESIDENTIAL AND MULTIFAMILY LAND USE

content.title: 5-1-6-1. General limitations.
content.summary:
A.	Generally. The standards of this Section apply to all lots that are developed with nonresidential uses, vertically mixed-use buildings, and multifamily buildings.
B.	Applicable Standards.
